title: Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94)
function: Split cotter pin for hinge/clevis retention
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this fastener application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by split cotter pin for hinge/clevis retention and service environment demands.
process: CNC turning and boring for fastener geometry

commonFailures: Galvanic corrosion at dissimilar interfaces — critical for split cotter pin performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) suitable for Split cotter pin for hinge/clevis retention?
faq.a: Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address fastener operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for split cotter pin requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. split cotter pin components require Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for split cotter pin application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Cotter Pin (DIN 94) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet split cotter pin specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
